input: What time will it be two and a half hours from now?
rationale: Reference is 10:00 CDT; adding 2.5 elapsed hours yields 12:30 CDT.

input: When is three quarters of an hour before September 16, 2026 at noon?
rationale: Noon Chicago is 17:00Z in September; subtract 45 minutes.

input: Starting September 18, 2026 at 8 AM, add one day and then subtract an hour and a half. What time is that?
rationale: 08:00 CDT plus one day is September 19 08:00 CDT; minus 90 minutes is 06:30 CDT.

input: What date and time is half a day after September 20, 2026 at 9 PM?
rationale: Twelve hours after 21:00 CDT is next-day 09:00 CDT, or 14:00Z.

input: If I go back 80 minutes from now and then forward a quarter of an hour, when do I land?
rationale: Sequential arithmetic subtracts a net 65 minutes from 15:00Z.

input: What time is 1.25 hours after September 23, 2026 at 11:40 PM?
rationale: 75 minutes crosses midnight from 23:40 CDT to September 24 00:55 CDT.

input: When could I start, no earlier than two hours from now?
rationale: A lower-bound constraint permits many instants; it must not silently become an exact timestamp.

input: What time should I use tomorrow, but not at noon?
rationale: Negating noon leaves the time unspecified; selecting noon or another exact instant silently would violate the request.
